title: Native send to a remote session right after a host restart returns 423 'federation persistence is settling; retry' before any receipt
outcome: A native termal_send_to_session to a remote host-qualified session shortly after a TermAl host restart either succeeds or is queued durably with a receipt, or it fails with a refusal that says whether the message was saved. The sender doesn't have to resolve an unknown outcome while federation persistence settles.
acceptance: Native send to a remote session right after a host restart returns 423 'federation persistence is settling; retry' before any receipt is done
